raw.source: US BIS - Department of Commerce Rescinds Biden-Era Firearms Rule, Restoring Common Sense to Export Controls on Civilian Firearms
raw.content_en: BIS has rescinded the Biden-era firearms export rule, easing licensing and classification treatment for civilian firearms and ammunition. Exporters of firearms (HS 9302, 9303.20, 9303.30) and related parts to the US market should re-verify ECCN/ITAR boundary classification, confirm whether items now fall under EAR controls or move to Commerce licensing, and re-screen end users and consignees against the Entity List and restricted party lists. Align the 10-digit HTS line with Section 301 exposure and retain end-use/end-user statements. Note that rescission does not remove ITAR jurisdiction for military-grade items; dual-use and military firearms remain controlled.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部工业与安全局（BIS）撤销了拜登时期的枪械出口规则，放宽了民用枪械及弹药的许可与分类处理。向美国市场出口枪械（HS 9302、9303.20、9303.30）及相关零部件的出口商，应重新核实 ECCN/ITAR 边界分类，确认相关物项现归 EAR 管制还是转由商务部许可，并针对实体清单及受限方名单重新筛查最终用户与收货人。将 10 位 HTS 编码与 301 关税风险对齐，并留存最终用途/最终用户声明。注意：撤销规则并不解除军用级物项的 ITAR 管辖，两用及军用枪械仍受管制。

checklist.desc: Re-verify whether civilian firearms and parts now fall under EAR ECCN controls or remain ITAR-controlled; document the classification rationale for each SKU.
Re-screen all US consignees, distributors, and end users against the BIS Entity List, OFAC SDN, and denied persons lists before shipment.
Map each item to the correct 10-digit HTS line (9302/9303) and check Section 301 additional duty exposure; record country of origin and value build-up.
Obtain and retain non-transferable end-use and end-user certificates for firearms and ammunition shipments to the US.
Confirm whether a BIS license or license exception applies post-rescission and keep the authorization record with the export file.
Verify DOT/IMDG dangerous goods classification and packaging for ammunition and propellant components before US entry.
